Title: Some users may be unable to open or upload attachments in the Outlook new client

User impact: Users may be unable to open or upload attachments in the Outlook new client.

More info: Affected users may be able to utilize Outlook on the web or the Outlook classic client to open or upload attachments.
 
Current status: We've received reports indicating an issue with opening or uploading attachments in the Outlook new client. We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps.
 
Scope of impact: Some users attempting to open or upload attachments in email messages may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
 
Next update by: Friday, November 20, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC
